CHIEF COMPLAINT
Left ankle pain and swelling after fall.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Stephanie Morales is a 36-year-old female presenting with left ankle pain and swelling. Two days ago, patient slipped on snow and ice while walking to her car. Her left ankle twisted underneath her on the outside/lateral aspect and she fell. She was able to get up but experienced significant soreness, swelling, and pain making ambulation difficult. Patient has tried ibuprofen, ice, and elevation with minimal improvement. Pain is localized to the outside of the ankle with no involvement of the calf, lower leg, or knee. No bleeding noted, though swelling is present.

Denies pain above ankle, in calf, lower leg, or knee. Denies bleeding. Positive for swelling and pain localized to left ankle.
